question: Can the SBFZ PEPRMP cited in the Subic International Golf Club EIS be located through public search, and does the accessible timeline help identify the exact source?

boundedQueries: Subic Bay Freeport Zone PEPRMP 2012 fish exploratory surveys March April September 2012
Subic Bay exploratory fish surveys PEPRMP
Berkman Systems PEPRMP Subic Bay report fish
Programmatic Environmental Performance Report Subic Bay Freeport Berkman 2012 PDF
PEPRMP Progress Report for SBFZ Berkman
Subic Bay Freeport Zone Progress Report PEPRMP Berkman Systems
search.primaryReportResult: No direct copy of the SBFZ PEPRMP progress report, fish annex, species list, or underlying exploratory-survey tables was located in these bounded public searches. This does not prove that no copy exists.
search.directAccess: The report cited by the 2021/2020-era Subic golf EIS remains a citation-only primary-source lead; no report URL, report number, final title page, or item-specific reuse terms were verified.

chamberNewsletter.finding: The September 2012 SBFCC newsletter identifies Berkman Systems Inc. as the SBMA PEPRMP contractor, says the contract was awarded in September 2011, says the nine-month study began in February 2012 and was expected to finish in October 2012, and characterizes the then-presented material as preliminary.
chamberNewsletter.limitation: Secondary newsletter timeline only; it is not the report and does not establish delivery, finalization, fish sampling methods, taxa, or fish-to-waterbody assignments.

newspaperExcerpt.finding: A publisher-indexed December 2012 article excerpt reports that the Berkman study had not yet been completed and was still at a preliminary stage.
newspaperExcerpt.limitation: Direct page access returned HTTP 403; this is only a search-index excerpt and a contemporaneous status clue, not proof that the project was never finalized.

citedFishLineage.finding: The golf EIS footnote attributes its Table 4-48 checkmarks to exploratory Subic Bay fish surveys in March-April and September 2012 and calls the source PEPRMP, SBFZ.
citedFishLineage.limitation: The EIS does not provide a full bibliographic citation or the underlying row-level table lineage; it is not enough to identify the exact PEPRMP version or reconcile the table independently.

decision: Close this bounded retrieval attempt as unresolved. Keep the 2012 PEPRMP as a research lead only; do not copy or infer species names, occurrences, dates, stations, abundance, current presence, diet, safety, or fishing rules from secondary timeline coverage. Prioritize independently reusable, site-resolved sources for the L3 app evidence pipeline rather than waiting on this report.

disposition.regionalCoverageStatus: partial; L3 remains reviewing and baselineReviewed=false

nextAction: Continue the L3 source sweep with independently reusable records and primary studies for rivers, reservoirs, wetlands, estuaries, and marine waters. Reopen the PEPRMP lead only if a lawful primary copy becomes publicly available or permission is established.

sources.supports: Official EIS indexed footnote that identifies March-April and September 2012 exploratory fish surveys as PEPRMP/SBFZ.
September 2012 Chamber newsletter project timeline and preliminary-status description; secondary source only.
Search-indexed December 2012 report excerpt on the contemporary preliminary/incomplete status; direct page returned HTTP 403.
